biggest_catch: Only IMCU members with an active Health Savings Account qualify — and the account must stay open at least 1 year or the bonus is clawed back at closing.
catches: Must be an IMCU member with an active Health Savings Account (HSA) — this is not the general IMCU200 offer, which expired per creditdonkey (3/24/2026); the live offer on imcu.com is this HSA-targeted one.
Use promo code "HSA200" when adding the checking account online (forms.fivision.com) or at an IMCU branch.
Requires a NEW checking account (consumer Regular or Preferred Checking) and a NEW net direct deposit — $400 minimum per deposit.
The $200 is deposited automatically after two payrolls post.
Account must remain open at least 1 year — closing earlier means the bonus is debited back (clawback).
Free checking requires eStatements; membership savings account required; not available on commercial or fresh-start checking.
Limited-time offer expires 02/28/2027; cannot be combined with other offers.
Membership eligibility required (central/southern Indiana field of membership).

steps: As an IMCU member with an active Health Savings Account, add a FREE Regular or Preferred Checking account using promo code "HSA200" — online via the application link on imcu.com/special-member-offer, or at your local IMCU branch.
Set up direct deposit from your employer into the new IMCU checking account (minimum $400 per deposit).
Once two payroll deposits have posted, the $200 bonus is automatically deposited into the new checking account.
Keep the account open for at least 1 year — closing earlier means the bonus is debited back.
timing: Account setup and direct-deposit enrollment take 30–60 min active; $200 posts automatically after two qualifying payroll deposits; keep the account open ≥1 year to avoid clawback.
